generation.title: Your first week
generation.body: We're putting together meals that fit everyone at your table.
generation.offlineBody: Creating a plan needs a connection. Your answers are saved.
generation.failedBody: Nothing is lost. You can try again or start from a simple family plan we adjust for you.
generation.clinicianTitle: Please check with your doctor first
generation.templateNote: This is a starter plan adjusted for your family. You can swap any meal.
generation.timeout: This is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting or use a simple starter plan.

tips.water: Water 20 to 30 minutes before a meal, sips during, and freely after.
tips.plate: Half the plate vegetables and fruit, a quarter protein, a quarter grains.
tips.pace: Taking about 20 minutes over a meal helps you notice when you've had enough.
tips.children: Children decide how much; you decide what and when.
tips.bismillah: Starting with Bismillah and eating together makes a meal calmer.
tips.seconds: Children can always have seconds when they're still hungry.
